title: Phrase
description: Serialized form of a Phrase. CANONICAL form omits `raga` (inherited from the piece). On load, (ratios, fundamental) are threaded from the piece raga down through trajectoryGrid; if absent, the phrase's own embedded `raga` (LEGACY) supplies fallback context.

trajectoryGrid.description: String-indexed grid: trajectoryGrid[string][i] = Trajectory. Row 0 = main string.

raga.description: LEGACY ONLY — stripped in canonical form (inherited from piece). If present, used as fallback context for threading.
